subject: maths
title: Telling the Time to the Quarter Hour
seo_title: Year 2 Telling the Time Worksheets: O’clock, Half Past, Quarter Past and Quarter To (Free, with Answers)
standard_text: Recognise and read the time represented on an analog clock to the hour, half-hour and quarter-hour
meta_desc: Free Year 2 maths worksheets on telling the time on an analog clock: o’clock, half past, quarter past and quarter to, matching analog and digital times, and daily routines. 100 questions with an answer key, following the Australian Curriculum.
key_big: Short hand: the hour. Long hand: o’clock, quarter past, half past or quarter to.
key_sub: Long hand on 12: o’clock. On 3: quarter past. On 6: half past. On 9: quarter to the next hour, so quarter to 4 is 3:45.

faq.q: What time should a Year 2 student be able to tell in Australia?
faq.a: In the Australian Curriculum (AC9M2M04), Year 2 students read the time on an analog clock to the hour, half-hour and quarter-hour: o’clock, half past, quarter past and quarter to.

faq.q: What does quarter to mean on a clock?
faq.a: Quarter to means 15 minutes before the next hour. The long hand points to the 9, so quarter to 4 is 3:45.
No. NAPLAN is for Years 3, 5, 7 and 9. In Year 3, students build on these clock skills and read the time to the nearest minute.

faq.q: How can I help my child learn to tell the time?
faq.a: Use a real analog clock at home and ask the time at everyday moments, such as breakfast, school pick-up and bedtime. Start with o’clock and half past, then quarter past and quarter to.

items.e: When the long hand goes all the way round, the short hand moves from one number to the next. From 3 o’clock to 4 o’clock is 1 hour.

items.q: School starts at 9 o’clock. Aarav gets to school at quarter to 9. Is he early or late?
items.e: Quarter to 9 is 15 minutes before 9 o’clock (8:45). So Aarav is early, by 15 minutes.

items.q: Assembly starts at quarter past 9. It ends at quarter to 10. How long is it?
items.e: Quarter past 9 is 9:15. Quarter to 10 is 9:45. The long hand goes from the 3 to the 9: half way round. Assembly is half an hour.
4 o’clock is 4:00, quarter past 4 is 4:15, half past 4 is 4:30, and quarter to 5 is 4:45. The latest is quarter to 5.

items.q: Put these times in order, earliest first.
c: quarter past 3, quarter to 4, half past 3
quarter to 4, quarter past 3, half past 3
half past 3, quarter past 3, quarter to 4
quarter past 3, half past 3, quarter to 4
items.e: Quarter past 3 is 3:15. Half past 3 is 3:30. Quarter to 4 is 3:45. So the order is quarter past 3, half past 3, quarter to 4.

items.q: Ava reads for a quarter of an hour. Harper reads for half an hour. Who reads for longer?
c: They read for the same time
items.e: A quarter of an hour is 15 minutes. Half an hour is 30 minutes. 30 is more than 15, so Harper reads for longer.
